text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks, Accu-san~ But I'm good now~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's the 6th time since I woke up. Even 
I get embarrassed after that many, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all it was up to now? Well 
then, let me pass on a bit more to you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tran-san, thank you for being born.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She always keeps a watchful eye around 
her, lending a hand to anyone who's having 
trouble... She's truly a splendid person, 
she is~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm not that great of an Umamusume. 
I'm just chatting folks up to gather info—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm. Even so, ya know, there are so, so 
many folks who've been saved by it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, on behalf of everyone too... I wanted 
to let you know how happy and grateful I 
truly am.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Tran-san. You're always 
such a good girl, good girl...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Accu-san, you've totally misunderstood 
who I am."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Man, oh man... ...I really can't 
beat you.
